Choose integers \(5\) and \(-100\), and fractions \(\frac12\) and \(-\frac1{100}\). Use the two operation types \(\times\) and \(\div\):

\[
(5 \times (-100)) \div \left(\frac12 \times \left(-\frac1{100}\right)\right)
= -500 \div \left(-\frac1{200}\right)
= 100000.
\]

Thus the resulting positive integer is \(\boxed{100000}\).
